spec.title: Guidance sharpens the conditional
spec.caption: Ho & Salimans 2022. w = 1 is the plain conditional model; image models typically sample at w ≈ 4–8.
spec.main_latex: D_w(x, \sigma \mid c) = D(x, \sigma \mid \varnothing) + w\,\big[D(x, \sigma \mid c) - D(x, \sigma \mid \varnothing)\big]

steps.explanation: In score form, guidance adds w times the gradient of an implicit classifier.
At σ = 0 that is the score of a tilted distribution: w > 1 concentrates mass where the condition is most certain. Diversity is traded for fidelity on purpose.
Unless the guidance scale is distilled into the network, as in FLUX.1 [dev]. The co-folding models in the gallery do not use guidance at all.
